items.why: Extending Friday's rally as AI infrastructure optimism builds. Reuters reported Meta plans to manufacture its custom 'Iris' AI chip from September, and BofA reiterated Buy with an $835 target.
Melius Research upgraded Microsoft to Buy from Hold with a $665 target, calling it the trusted 'adult in charge' as AI safety fears push enterprises toward Microsoft's secure wrappers.
Riding Friday's pop after Q3 deliveries of 486,532 vehicles beat the 450,000 to 460,000 analyst range. Investors now look ahead to the Oct. 21 earnings report.
Testing all-time highs with market cap near $5.7 trillion, per Yahoo Finance. Investor's Business Daily notes the stock is breaking out past a 234.76 buy point.

market_note: S&P and Nasdaq futures up about 0.3 to 0.5 percent; Dow futures down about 0.2 percent.
summary: Stocks are mixed this morning: the S&P 500 and Nasdaq edge higher on AI and software strength while the Dow slips as Treasury yields climb and oil falls.
